extracted.subtask_description: Editing or creating a Wikipedia biographical article (short/mid-length) to meet site standards: add verifiable sourcing, remove vague/ambiguous statements, and expand stub content. Focus is on improving article quality and compliance with Wikipedia guidelines.

rubrics_metrics.name: Needs additional citations for verification
rubrics_metrics.description: This article needs additional citations for verification. Please help improve this article by adding citations to reliable sources.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Unsourced material may be challenged and removed. Find sources: "Jack Kelley" journalist – news · newspapers · books · scholar · JSTOR (June 2024) (Learn how and when to remove this message).

rubrics_metrics.name: Use reliable sources (news, books, scholarly databases)
rubrics_metrics.description: Articles should cite reliable sources such as news outlets, newspapers, books, and scholarly databases (e.g., JSTOR) to verify claims.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The page explicitly suggests finding sources in categories like news, newspapers, books, scholar, JSTOR; follow Wikipedia sourcing guidelines when adding citations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Article is a stub — expand with missing information
rubrics_metrics.description: This article about a United States journalist born in the 20th century is a stub. You can help Wikipedia by adding missing information.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Expand the article with well-sourced biographical details, career history, and reliable references rather than adding unsourced claims.

rubrics_metrics.name: Avoid vague or ambiguous time expressions / provide specific dates
rubrics_metrics.description: The article has a hidden category 'Vague or ambiguous time' indicating it contains unclear time references.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Replace vague time expressions with specific dates or sourced timeframes where possible, and cite sources for timeline claims (e.g., resignation dates, investigation dates).

rubrics_metrics.name: Provide basic biographical completeness (e.g., year of birth)
rubrics_metrics.description: Hidden category: 'Year of birth missing (living people)' — the article lacks a basic biographical datum.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Add verifiable birth-year information (with reliable sourcing) to satisfy biographical completeness for living persons, following WP:BLP (biographies of living persons) policies.
